name: Snake Plant
personality: Survives neglect, gloom, and your longest holidays — mostly by ignoring you.

name: Golden Pothos
personality: Grows a metre of vine a year and asks for almost nothing in return.

name: ZZ Plant
personality: Runs on stored water and stubbornness; watering it weekly is the only way to lose it.

name: Spider Plant
personality: Churns out baby plants faster than you can rehome them.

name: Boston Fern
personality: Lush, dramatic, and thirsty — skip two waterings and it sheds like a headline.

name: Calathea Orbifolia
personality: Folds its striped leaves up each night and silently judges your tap water.

name: Parlour Palm
personality: Has tolerated dim Victorian parlours since 1850; your hallway is no challenge.

name: Aloe Vera
personality: Wants your sunniest sill, a drink a month, and otherwise total independence.
